!  to calculate change in equilibrium constants and also later to
    !  calculate planck-larkin sums in ionize.
    !  n.b. ion index here refers to neutral + all non-bare ions including
    !  h molecules
    do index = 1, max_index
       ion = partial_ions(index)
       arg_pl = tc2*bi(ion)
       if(arg_pl.gt.50._fp_kind) then
          plop(ion) = 0._fp_kind
          plopt(ion) = 0._fp_kind
          plopt2(ion) = 0._fp_kind
       else
          expmarg = exp(-arg_pl)
          plop(ion) = 1._fp_kind - expmarg*(1._fp_kind + arg_pl)
          plopt(ion) = -expmarg*arg_pl*arg_pl
          plopt2(ion) = expmarg*arg_pl*arg_pl*(2._fp_kind-arg_pl)
          plopt2(ion) = (plopt2(ion) - plopt(ion)*&
               plopt(ion)/plop(ion))/plop(ion)
          plopt(ion) = plopt(ion)/plop(ion)
          plop(ion) = log(plop(ion))
       endif
    enddo
    !  calculate change in equilibrium constant = mu/kt(ref) - mu/kt(ion)
scope: pl_prepare assigns plop only at partial_ions(1:max_index). Unvisited slots are outside this output contract. The stationarity trace reads only active atomic slices; inactive and molecular padding has no scientific value.
